answer.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ. Memory_86 and memory_91 show that both shortening onboarding and adding activation messaging have improved early adoption and engagement. Activation messaging (memory_91) offers a lower-risk, faster-to-deploy intervention than a full onboarding redesign. We're verifying memory_31 (signup simplification) and memory_91 (activation messaging) to confirm the magnitude and durability of these effects before choosing. Promotional pricing (memory_73) showed retention damage and is not repeatable. Referral incentives work for established customers but don't address the acute activation decline. Enterprise sales assist targets a different segment. Activation messaging can be deployed quickly within existing product surfaces, addresses the immediate activation decline, and has demonstrated durability. A standard experiment allows us to measure impact on the current cohort without overcommitting, and preserves the option to iterate or shift course if results underperform.
